source_verification_receipts.locator: p. 1140, Theorem 3 and equation (3.6); p. 1141, Theorem 4
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorem 3 gives an adaptive probability bound at exponent beta/(2 beta+1), equation (3.6) constrains A(delta), and Theorem 4 gives the companion adaptive lower bound with the log-log loss.
The paper establishes regular utilitarian policy-regret guarantees with a VC-complexity and efficient-score scale, distinct from the proposal's extreme-quantile loss.
Equation (4) minimizes the marginal policy cost (1-alpha)-quantile; the paper then constructs feature-decision conformal limits, which can be uninformative at max(Y) when data are inadequate.
